items.title: Harold Mabern interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, March 31, 2010
items.q: I wanted to work with Max Roach and Clifford Brown. Because remember when I came to New York, Booker Little and George Coleman was working with Max and they were getting ready to go to Philly so they didn’t have no piano... So I go into Max and started playing the piano kind of like to let them know

ctx.x: Well what was New York like for you the first time that you got there?

Oh, overwhelming. I couldn’t believe it. Even though I had read about it and seen pictures, but I couldn’t believe what I could hear, really, for all intents and purposes by myself, but even George Coleman was there and Booker Little because at that time, they were working with Max Roach’s group. But as far as family members, I was on my own. And I said at that point, you know, I was mature enough to know how to handle it and everything. I knew how to manage whatever little money I had, and not go through it. And…
